Tomorrow at 7 p.m. (Pacific time) we will start the first Twitch event in the key fight game that you can. The admins are waiting for you. More information will follow tomorrow.

- UI revision
- LAG compensation

   the reload ammo. If you walk trough with the handgun, it will pick up ammunition that ends up in 
   your inventory as a new ammunition box.  So you can hold it or drop it again.



if you notice any mistakes or anything else, please let me know. Everything relevant like the train, place of tower, sky lift, loot, etc. should work now.


Cheers Dave

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Hi gamers:

This week's update opens up the skies! Introducing the all new Hot Air Balloon! In this craft you will be able to get around the map quickly and in a future update you will also be able to use it as a mobile sniping platform.

I also fixed some bugs:

- Day-Night-Cycle works properly now.
- Night vision goggles now work after first depletion.
- The correct weapon is shown over the network.
- Your coins are saved correctly after you leave a room.

The in-game shop now allows you to buy the DLC with the in-game currency.

Have fun!
